**Finding: COMPLIANT** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Clear Capital, which matches the playbook's **preferred** position.

What I checked and why it doesn't trigger the rule:

- **§ 1 (Purpose of Engagement)** — the planner's flagged section — contains only scope, personnel, facilities and change-order mechanics. Nothing limits what Clear Capital may build, buy or sell.
- **§ 13 Non-Solicitation (p0047)** — mutual and reciprocal ("Neither party shall..."), 12 months post-termination, limited to personnel with direct involvement in the Services, with consent not to be unreasonably withheld. This is a personnel restraint, not a restraint on our business or sourcing, and it binds RadialSpark equally. Out of scope for NONCOMPETE.
- **§ 4 (p0020)** — "Company shall not resell or make use of said property in any other manner other than in connection with the software Company receives under this Agreement." This is a licence-scope limit on RadialSpark's *background* IP, not a field-of-use restriction on our own products or markets. Ordinary and not flagged here.

Clear Capital retains full freedom to develop competing products internally, engage other vendors, and acquire competing businesses. No walk-away or fallback issues arise.
